title: hackelia micrantha
intro: Hackelia micrantha, commonly known as smallbell, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Hackelia micrantha are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
